The '''S. Wall Flower''' is a [[furniture]] item that can be placed on a wall. It can be purchased from [[Pierre]] for {{Price|800}} during the [[Flower Dance]].

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
